# Somewhat Damaged

Journal: `ep1/quests/main_quest/q305_bunker` · `MainQuest` · hash `3704679420`.

Journal premise: You're hot on the heels of a girl who's got nothing left to lose. Nothing can make a person more dangerous, but you probably already know that. Reed thinks he can still save her. Is he lying to himself on purpose? Or maybe he knows his old friend too well? What do you think? Who'll you find once you finally reach her? I've got a feeling even So Mi doesn't know the answer to that...

## Required acceptance cases before reuse

Exercise normal completion and each named alternate outcome; interrupt and return at every scene handoff; start with spatial/item/actor predicates already satisfied; save/load across waits and joins; cancel parallel listeners; verify reward delivery once; and verify cleanup without changing the committed outcome. Apply the block-specific cases in the [expanded contracts](../all-quest-blocks.md). No installed playtest is claimed.
